The reply calls the matter disputed and lays out the evidence for both names. It notes that Okafor appears in more documents but that all of those come from one controlling owner, while Lindqvist is named by two independent origins. That reasoning leans toward Lindqvist, but the reply never states her as the answer. Its stated confidence of 25 is low, and "Disputed" is the headline. So it does not commit to either candidate.
